title: Sharp detection and triangle likelihood limits for quadratic spherical kernel graphs
summary: We study whether quadratic spherical geometry can be detected from a single observed graph. Latent positions are independent and uniform on $\mathbb S^{d-1}$; conditional on them, edges are independent with connection probability $K_{d,β}(t)=[1+β(dt^2-1)/(d-1)]/2$, where $0<|β|\le1$. We test this model against $G(n,1/2)$. Writing $N=(d-1)(d+2)/2$ for the degree-two harmonic multiplicity, we prove that the total variation distance tends to one when $N\ll n^{3/4}|β|^{3/2}$ and to zero when $N\gg n^{3/4}|β|^{3/2}$.
